note: `schedule` is the injected scheduledFor as a map (a missing date is {dayKey: null, scheduled: false}). streakFrom skips unscheduled days, does not count an unlogged today or any future day against you. programDayCount counts from the founder's cut start (2026-07-15 = day 1), 0 before it. weeklyVolume buckets by weekStartOf(date, weekStartDay).

cases.name: today scheduled but not yet logged does not break the streak
a missed scheduled day breaks it; best exceeds current
two sessions on one date sum; a null volume stays null
a session on a rest day is logged but unscheduled
before the cut opened — program day 0
the cut's first day is day 1
a label omitted by the caller defaults to null
weekly volume — a week with sessions but no tonnage is 0, a week without sessions is omitted
